issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a parameterless messageOnRide() method (used in Main and described in the UML and text), but the solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements messageOnRide with a String parameter in Pig and Seal. This parameter mismatch prevents code that calls messageOnRide() without arguments (as shown in the template Main and required by the spec) from compiling against the solution's interface and implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across artifacts. Either remove the String parameter from Rideable.messageOnRide and update Seal and Pig to implement public String messageOnRide() returning the expected string, or change the problem statement and template (including Main) to require and document messageOnRide(String equipment). Preferably, update the solution to match the spec/template by making messageOnRide() parameterless.
